component.name: RigSwap
component.summary: One-click graphics settings for every way you play

description.p: RigSwap keeps a separate copy of each game's graphics settings for each hardware setup you play on, such as a handheld, an eGPU dock or a laptop on battery, and switches all of them at once: by hand, or automatically when you dock.

ul.li: Imports games from Steam, Heroic and Lutris, including Proton and Wine prefixes
Finds config files automatically, recognises Unreal, Unity and Source games, and can learn where any other game keeps its settings
Switches automatically when an external GPU is connected or disconnected
Never switches under a running game, backs up before every switch, and can undo
